rationale: V3 lower-threshold masks improve some natural preference results but worsen full foreground-blur robustness on the completed 34-source diagnostic. Test pooling instead of gray pixel replacement, retaining the previous v2 independent masks.
encoder: Same pinned CLIP ViT-B/32, checkpoint, all frames, resize and center crop as origin. Retain the 49 contextualized visual patch tokens; apply the existing final LayerNorm and projection to each, with unchanged weights.
pooling: Float32 soft area-weighted sum of projected patch tokens, L2 normalized and cast to the original CLIP feature dtype. Global patch mean is a representation-only ablation.
mask_geometry: Apply the same first two VBench transform stages (bicubic Resize with antialias false, CenterCrop), clamp mask coverage to [0,1], then average into the 7x7 patch grid. Background weights are complements of independently predicted foreground coverage.
localizer: Use content/asset/hash-verified v2 per-actual-variant scoring masks, never construction masks or masks propagated across changed pixels. Natural/native: COCO threshold 0.8 and MobileSAM. The reused diagnostic retains its previously documented subject-specific scoring localization.
missing_background: A missing-background frame contributes zero to every containing temporal pair at a fixed denominator.
limitations: CLIP patch tokens already share transformer context. This method is a hypothesis, not a guarantee of foreground isolation; actual nuisance, background and natural tests decide.
test_status: NOT RUN; no test scores or preference labels used in method development. Freeze final candidate and all gates before any heldout scoring.
